name: 33965 · Fort Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33965 (Fort Myers) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 33965 (Fort Myers) has 10 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Where do people here come together, and who brings them together? Which of those places would not show up in nonprofit records?
